thread:
sam: Thanks everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands. Leaving a short Q&A thread for any clarifying questions about mission, positioning, and what this means for team priorities. I'll start: how should teams think about prioritizing Dedicated vs Hosted improvements?

maria: TL;DR: bias to Hosted for product velocity. Move to Dedicated when customers need fixed capacity/SLA or data isolation. We'll publish thresholds.

jin: @maria will those thresholds be explicit? engineering needs to plan branching and infra work.

maria: Yes — playbook next week. High-level signals: sustained spend above our threshold, 99.95% SLO requirement, or regulatory constraints trigger Dedicated discussion.

drew: From sales perspective, we sometimes recommend Dedicated earlier for strategic accounts even below the spend threshold — contract dynamics matter.

zoe: On the mission: some partners asked if we were shifting away from "developer-first". Any reframing?

sam: Mission remains developer-first. Small tweak to external framing: lead with "production economics for LLM features" — highlights cost/latency/reliability, not just access.

lisa: About competitors: do we chase lowest-cost inference vendors or double down on reliability/observability to differentiate?

sam: Two-track approach: keep cost-competitive via Optimize tooling and quantization guidance, but our primary differentiation is predictable performance + observability. We won't be a bare-metal cheapest play.

jin: Practically for roadmap: should infra teams prioritize automatic fallback/routing policies or invest in catalog UX?

maria: Prioritize fallback/routing policies — keeps customer apps resilient. Catalog UX improvements are important but scheduled for the following sprint.

ops-bot: Reminder: Weekly strategy sync Thu 11:00 — add items to the shared doc: https://redwood.internal/strategy (automated notice)

drew: Will CS get clearer signals when a workspace is approaching Dedicated eligibility so we can proactively outreach?

maria: Yes — CS will receive a dashboard flag combining usage, cost trajectory, and SLO signals. Pilot next month.

zoe: Can someone craft a one-sentence positioning line for marketing to use externally?

sam: Draft: "Redwood Inference enables predictable, cost-effective LLM inference across hosted, reserved, and private deployments so teams ship reliable AI features without owning the stack." Thoughts?

maria: Nice. Suggest adding ops dimension: insert "and observable" after "cost-effective".

sam: Good tweak — I'll iterate and post a final blurb. Thanks all. Keep questions here and we'll update the playbook when it's ready. :rocket:
